name: Names For God
overview: The names of God revealed in Scripture demonstrate His character and His relationship with His people. From Jehovahjireh, the Lord who provides (Genesis 22:14), to I AM THAT I AM, the self-existent and eternal One (Exodus 3:14), these names reveal God's nature and His faithfulness. He is also Jehovahshalom, the Lord who sends peace (Judges 6:24), Jehovah that healeth thee (Exodus 15:26), and a personal protector and shepherd who sustains and delivers His people (Psalms 18:2; 23:1). These names invite believers to trust in God's provision, presence, healing, peace, and strength.
